caption:
New calls and positions on clinicalresearchchaos.com: 99 open funding calls and 86 academic positions, every one checked on the official text before it goes online.

By the numbers:
• 99 open calls in clinical research, rehabilitation and clinical engineering
• 42 open internationally
• 86 PhD, post-doc and faculty positions in 16 countries
• 11 methodology carousels you can swipe on the site, no Instagram account needed

Asia is growing fast: 31 open positions in Hong Kong, mainland China, the UAE, Vietnam, Japan and Taiwan, and new funders from India, Japan, Korea, China and Taiwan.

Latin America: coming soon.

New on the site: filters by medical area (neurology, physiatry and orthopaedics, ageing, oncology and haematology, clinical genetics and rare diseases), calendar reminders, RSS feeds and a feedback page to suggest a call or report an error.

And we are now on Threads and Bluesky too.

Which country or funder should we add next? Tell us in the comments.

All calls and positions: clinicalresearchchaos.com
Instagram & Threads: @clinicalresearchchaos
Bluesky: @researchchaos.bsky.social

Always check eligibility and deadlines in the official call or advertisement.
